sources.citation: real-world: 1 trade size steel EMT, outside diameter 1.163 in = 29.54 mm, nominal wall 0.057 in = 1.45 mm; steel-EMT makers’ published dimension tables for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number), read 2026-11-12. No NEC Chapter 9 table is used. The body box rounds the diameter up to 30 mm (even, so the ends sit on whole millimetres).

real-world (product data): makers’ standard 90° steel EMT elbows for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number) have a 146 mm centreline radius (5.75 in) and straight legs of 76 mm (3.0 in) at each end (makers’ elbow sheets, read 2026-11-12; a second maker gives 5.80 in for 1 in). Product data, not a code table of minimum bend radii; bends are not checked in P3.
game-design: the elbow’s box is its leg plus its bend radius plus half its body diameter, square; its ends are on the box’s faces so joined parts touch.
